result.brief: 提出面向 LLM 驱动机器人操作的故障注入与鲁棒性评测框架，对比 LLM 规划器与脚本规划器，定位失败源于输出序列化接口而非物理或推理能力。
result.reason: Fault-injection benchmark for LLM-driven manipulation planning in simulation; no world model, representation learning, or generative contribution, and it is a robustness evaluation harness rather than embodied world modeling.
